messages:
Ravi: Heads-up — Marigold wants a short performance validation tomorrow 07:30 PT. Goal: sustained 350 qps (50% chat, 50% embeds) for 25m with two 10s microbursts to 900 qps. Need final ops checklist + a quick quote they can approve.
Zoe: model/quant pin? dedicated or hosted?
Ravi: Dedicated trial in us-west-2. Pin to rdx/chat-pro-v2 + rdx/embed-pro (prefer 8-bit where available). Fallback: rdx/chat-small + rdx/embed-lite. Cache prefix ON, TTL=300s. Warm-up: 8m ramp to target.
Tom: ops recs: run on 3 nodes (each equivalent to A100x1), autoscale min=2 max=5, batch tuning: embeds batch=128, chat batch=24. Disable preemption for the window. Expose /metrics and stream to their dashboard.
BenchBot: bench command suggestion:
```
rdx-bench --mix chat:0.5,embed:0.5 --target 350 --ramp 00:08:00 --duration 00:25:00 \
  --burst 900:00:00:10 --model-pair rdx/chat-pro-v2,rdx/embed-pro --quant 8bit --cache-ttl 300
```
SecurityBot: NDA signed. KMS in us-west-2 required. They asked about log retention and encrypted ephemeral traces — we can redact user IDs and provide encrypted-at-rest confirmation. HSM not required for POC; SOC2 copy is available (redacted).
Ravi: quick cost math for quote: assume avg chat tokens per response = 10, embeddings billed per call. tokens = 350 * 1500s * 0.5 * 10 = 2,625,000 tokens. at blended $0.00044/token => ~$1,155. Embeddings: 350 * 1500 * 0.5 = 262,500 embeds * $0.00018 = ~$47. Ops/monitoring/support and buffer => propose $1.6k for the run. Will itemize in email.
Tom: noted dry-run numbers: chat p50=52ms p95=200ms p99=510ms; embeds p50=14ms p95=48ms p99=120ms. We saw tail spikes during cold-starts; prefix cache knocked p99 down ~30%. Microburst behavior: when queue latency >1.6s we saw 3% 5xx. Recommend circuit-breaker=1.5s soft-reject and queue-reject at 2s.
Zoe: buyer asked: what happens if dedicated pool saturates?
Tom: routing policy prefer=dedicated, fallback to hosted-compatible variants with circuit-breaker 1.5s. We'll document in runbook and call out degraded perf for fallbacks.
Ravi: Ops, can we add their allowlist 54.201.2.0/28 for the run window?
Tom: yes, will add IP allowlist and open dashboard share. I'll also add alert: 5xx > 2% for 90s.
Zoe: any enterprise blockers?
SecurityBot: SOC2 redacted ready, NDA annex for log retention pending signature from their legal (should be quick). HSM procurement estimated 4-6w if they need it beyond POC.
Ravi: ok green to run. Zoe, please send formal quote + runbook + security note to buyer and cc ops. We'll do a 20m post-run debrief and send results.
Zoe: sending now. tagging buyer email after thread.
Tom: I'll be oncall for the run and will stream /metrics. Ping if >5% 5xx.
Ravi: action items: Zoe->quote + security note, Tom->allowlist + dashboard + runbook, SecurityBot->NDA annex. Run scheduled 1777701234 07:30 PT. Post-run debrief at 1777702500 (~20m after). :white_check_mark:
